texto: Two quick dull muffled knocks on padded cloth, low pitched, clear and close, dry foley, no reverb
A firm punch into a stuffed pillow, clear soft thump with a little cloth rustle, loud and close, dry foley, no reverb
A small metal thimble struck once with a metal needle, loud clear bright ting with a short ring, close-mic, dry
Giant heavy steel tailor shears slamming shut once, loud sharp metallic snip followed by a short ringing metal resonance, close-mic, dry, dramatic
A stiff paper card flicked with a finger once, loud crisp snap of paper, close-mic, dry
A tight string plucked and immediately going slack, short descending twang, clear and close, dry
